alate: Head of the alate dark brown, labrum, postclypeus, anterior angles of the frons and mouthparts rusty yellow, antennae brown. Head densely covered with hairs, the pronotum also densely hairy. Head broadly oval, the postclypeus less than half as long as wide; the distance between ocellus and compound eye shorter than half the width of the ocellus; fontanelle oval, rather large. Antennae with 15 segments, segments 2 and 4 about equal in length, both longer than segment 3. Pronotum brownish yellow, with a yellow T-shaped marking and humeral markings, the posterior margin slightly concave. Media of the forewing with one to three branches.
